# Moritz Philipp Haaf, Football Data Scientist

> Football Data Scientist based in Vienna, Austria. Builds computer-vision and tracking-data pipelines that turn broadcast match footage into player positions and spatial metrics such as pitch control, validated against ground truth, for recruitment and match analysis. Senior Digital Data & Dashboard Manager at Publicis Media. Open to football data science roles (EU & UK).

## Credentials
- EMEA Finalist, AWS World Sports Innovation Cup 2026 (Football Body Intelligence Platform)
- MSc Artificial Intelligence Applied to Sports (completed)

## Projects
- Pitch-Control from Broadcast Video: YOLOv11n, ByteTrack, TVCalib, validated against SoccerNet GSR ground truth. Report: https://github.com/itzmore-mph/soccernet-setpiece-vision/blob/main/report.md
- Football Body Intelligence Platform: 700M+ TRACAB 3D skeleton points on AWS S3, SageMaker and Bedrock
- World Cup of Data: co-authored 2026 FIFA World Cup match analyses for Sports Data Campus: https://worldcup2026.sportsdatacampus.com/
- Bundesliga Performance and Valuation Analysis
- Scouting data pipeline for a professional club (NDA)

## Experience
- Senior Digital Data & Dashboard Manager, Publicis Media, Vienna
- Football Data Scientist, freelance
- Football Systems Operator, Hawk-Eye Innovations, Austria

## Skills
Python, SQL, computer vision, broadcast tracking, TRACAB tracking data, StatsBomb and Wyscout event data, xG, pitch control, AWS, Power BI, Tableau
